subject: FreshMart reported silent completions — triage outcomes and recommended next steps
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@freshmart.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-07T15:22:00Z
Subject: Intermittent blank completions from Redwood API (multiple request IDs)

Hi Irene,

We're seeing occasional completions return an empty body (HTTP 200 but blank text) when calling the /v1/completions endpoint from our backend. This started yesterday evening and has affected ~8 requests so far. I attached a screencap and zipped logs.

Example request IDs: r-7f3b2, r-7f3b8, r-80312.

Can you confirm whether there was any platform degradation in us-west-2 between 02/06 22:00 and 02/07 03:00 PST? FreshMart relies on these responses for checkout summaries so this is high priority.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Sr. SRE, FreshMart

Attachments: screencap-blank-completion.png, request-logs-2027-02-07.json

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Hi Emily — thanks for the report and the logs. I'm triaging now and looping in our runtime team.

Quick notes:
- We don't have any signal of a service-wide outage in us-west-2 for that window.
- I'll run the exact request IDs through our request tracing and ask for additional logs if needed.
- Can you confirm the model version you were hitting and whether you were using streaming?

I'll follow up with findings within 24 hours.

Best,
Irene Choi
Support Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent blank completions from FreshMart — replay results

Irene — quick summary from the runtime replay:

- We replayed the three request IDs against archived traces and live replayer (same model variant, same sequence lengths). All three returned non-empty completions when executed in our environment. Payloads in archived traces show normal token streams.
- Control plane telemetry shows no rate-limit or infra retries for FreshMart's project during the window indicated.
- One anomaly: for r-80312 we see a mid-request client-cancel on the TCP connection from the source IP recorded in the FreshMart logs. That could explain an empty body if the client closed the connection before receiving the response.
- No evidence of a model or kernel failure in the runtime.

Recommendation:
- Reply to FreshMart with our findings, call out the client-cancel observed for r-80312, and offer to keep monitoring. Suggest they check any HTTP client/timeout/retry logic that may close streams early.
- Offer to enable additional request-level logging (short retention) for 48 hours if they want live coverage.

If you want, I can draft the closure note to send to Emily.

Marissa
Principal Runtime Engineer

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-02-08T10:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Intermittent blank completions from Redwood API (multiple request IDs) — findings and next steps

Hi Emily — thanks again for the logs. We completed an initial replay and triage. Summary below and recommended next steps: 

Summary of findings:
- We replayed the three request IDs you provided (r-7f3b2, r-7f3b8, r-80312) using the same model variant and parameters. In our environment all three returned non-empty completions; archived traces show normal token output.
- For r-80312 we observed a client-side TCP connection close recorded in FreshMart's request metadata (appears in the logs you attached). That matches a scenario where a 200 status could be returned but the connection closed before the body completed streaming to the client.
- No platform-wide degradation or runtime errors were observed in us-west-2 for the timeframe you indicated.

Recommended next steps:
1) Please check FreshMart's HTTP client timeouts and retry behavior for the ingestion path that calls our API; a premature close would explain the symptom.
2) If you'd like, we can enable request-level live logging (48-hour window) and keep an engineer on standby to correlate any future incidents.
3) If you can reproduce the behavior, please capture the raw tcpdump or full request/response bytes for at least one occurrence and share with us — that'll help confirm whether the body was truncated in transit.

We're happy to keep monitoring. If you prefer we can also open a short Joint Debug session with your SREs.

Best,
Irene Choi
Support Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: request-logs-2027-02-07.json (hosted), JIRA INF-4892

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@freshmart.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@freshmart.com
Date: 2027-02-09T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: RE: Intermittent blank completions from Redwood API (multiple request IDs) — findings and next steps

Thanks for the quick turn, Irene and team.

We dug into our client side and found a flaky keepalive setting on one of the service instances that can close idle connections aggressively. We haven't seen more occurrences since we patched the keepalive to the recommended values yesterday evening.

Please consider this resolved on our side for now — we appreciate the replay and offer to monitor. We'll re-open the ticket if we see recurrence and can capture a raw dump.

Thanks,
Emily
Sr. SRE, FreshMart
